### ⚠️ Security sensitive changes

This maintainer PR changes sensitive security components. This comment is informational because the PR author has repository Maintain or Admin access.

- Current SHA: `f5aff322ea17cb05b49ced90fe0837ed75b5e4b2`
- Maintainer: @steipete
- Repository role: `admin`

These security sensitive changes were made:

- `src/logging/diagnostic-support-redaction.ts`: Controls credential persistence, secret resolution, or redaction. Check storage permissions, credential scope, and exposure in logs or responses.

Carefully review these changes before merging.

Codex review: needs real behavior proof before merge. _Reviewed September 23, 2026, 11:01 AM ET / 15:01 UTC._ # ClawSweeper review ## What this changes Allows writable system-service installations to update their packages, preserves operator-controlled restarts, and delays replacement-triggered Gateway shutdown until the updater settles. ## Regression provenance Possible regression — suspected (reviewed change). No predecessor PR is attributed. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Blocked before merge - 5 items remain** The repair remains necessary and has substantial live validation, but the newly admitted system-service path can continue after a profile requester’s access grant is revoked. **Priority:** P0 **Reviewed head:** `f5aff322ea17cb05b49ced90fe0837ed75b5e4b2` ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Strong operational proof and a coherent repair are limited by an introduced requester-authorization defect. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Needs stronger real behavior proof before merge: Authority-chain proof required: supplied live CLI/RPC traces substantiate package replacement, permission refusal, warning persistence, and settlement, but do not cover a profile requester whose access-policy grant is revoked during validation. Preserve that positive evidence and add redacted final-effect traces for allowed and revoked grants, showing refusal before package mutation and safe settlement. No stored-data contract changes are introduced. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. | | **Patch quality** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Security review found an item that needs attention. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Needs proof | Needs stronger real behavior proof before merge: Authority-chain proof required: supplied live CLI/RPC traces substantiate package replacement, permission refusal, warning persistence, and settlement, but do not cover a profile requester whose access-policy grant is revoked during validation. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 9 items | Introduced changes and merge ownership: Reviewed the pinned merge-base-to-head delta. Raw test-merge parents are the pinned base followed by the exact PR head; its handoff changes retain the cancellation guard and forced no-restart path.
Current main still refuses system-service updates: The fetched main revision still throws the blanket user-scope requirement before creating the update handoff owner.
Published-driver limitation: The v2026.9.5 source contains the same refusal. The PR documents the one-time manual bootstrap rather than claiming candidate code can repair the already-running driver. | | **Findings** | 1 actionable finding | [P1] Preserve requester revocation before system-service activation | | **Security** | Needs attention | Revoked profile access can retain package-update authority: The new cancellation guard and no-restart path bypass the original grant revalidation while identity-only continuation checks remain satisfied, allowing a previously authorized requester to reach package mutation after grant revocation. | ## How this fits together The update handoff connects Gateway update requests to a detached package updater. It controls admission, process lifetime, and reporting while leaving system-service restarts to the operator. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[CLI or Gateway update request] --> B[Service scope and permission checks] B -->|Not writable| C[Recovery instructions] B -->|Writable system installation| D[Detached package updater] D --> E[Package replacement and recorded warning] D --> F[Helper settlement barrier] F --> G[Gateway shutdown and operator restart] ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Add real behavior proof** - Needs stronger real behavior proof before merge: Authority-chain proof required: supplied live CLI/RPC traces substantiate package replacement, permission refusal, warning persistence, and settlement, but do not cover a profile requester whose access-policy grant is revoked during validation. Preserve that positive evidence and add redacted final-effect traces for allowed and revoked grants, showing refusal before package mutation and safe settlement. No stored-data contract changes are introduced. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. - [ ] **Preserve requester revocation before system-service activation (P1)** - For a profile-authorized chat update, revoke the access-policy plugin grant while the updater is staging or validating. This new guard returns `cancel-unavailable` as soon as the updater starts. The added `--no-restart` path also skips `prepareTransferredGateway`, so the original Gateway-held grant is never checked through `beforePark`. The updater continuation checks native custody and profile identity, but deliberately does not check that plugin grant (`createManagedUpdateRequesterContinuationAuthority` and `captureLinkedOperatorAdminIdentity`). Package replacement can therefore proceed after revocation. Preserve a live authorization check before activation without restoring unsafe SIGKILL of an updater that may already be writing. - [ ] **Resolve security concern: Revoked profile access can retain package-update authority** - The new cancellation guard and no-restart path bypass the original grant revalidation while identity-only continuation checks remain satisfied, allowing a previously authorized requester to reach package mutation after grant revocation. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - A profile administrator whose access-policy grant is revoked during system-service update validation can retain the ability to replace the installed package. - [ ] **Complete next step (P2)** - Repair requester-grant revocation handling and provide final-effect proof that revoked access cannot reach package activation. ## Findings - [P1] Preserve requester revocation before system-service activation — `src/infra/update-managed-service-handoff.ts:1152-1153` - [high] Revoked profile access can retain package-update authority — `src/infra/update-managed-service-handoff.ts:1153`
